A LITTLE ABOUT US

Good dentistry. A better feeling.

Welcome to Dr. Bobby Thomas Dental & Implant Centre. We believe great dental care begins with listening, thoughtful guidance and a comfortable experience.

From everyday dental needs to smile-enhancing treatments, our focus is on helping every patient make informed choices about their oral health.

OPEN POSITIONS

Current openings.

These are sample listings. Don’t see your role? Send a general enquiry and we’ll keep it on file.

Associate Dentist (General & Restorative)

Full-timeBengaluru1–3 yrs experience

Provide examinations, restorations and preventive care for a varied patient base, working closely with senior clinicians.

You will plan treatment with patients, keep clear records and take part in regular case discussions. A BDS degree and valid state dental council registration are required.

Implantologist

Full-time / VisitingBengaluruExperience preferred

Join the implant and smile rehabilitation team, supporting assessment, planning and placement under a collaborative case-review approach.

Candidates should hold relevant implant training and registration. Mentoring time with the founding dentist is part of the role.

Orthodontist (Braces & Aligners)

Part-time / VisitingBengaluruMDS preferred

Plan and review braces and clear aligner cases, and support the cosmetic and smile design work of the clinic.

Weekly clinic days with scheduled review appointments. Digital planning experience is a plus.

Dental Assistant

Full-timeBengaluru0–2 yrs experience

Assist chairside, prepare instruments and rooms, and help every patient feel comfortable from arrival to departure.

Training is provided in sterilisation, infection control and chairside procedures. A caring attitude matters more than years of experience.

Front Desk & Patient Coordinator

Full-timeBengaluru1+ yrs experience

Be the first friendly face and voice of the clinic: manage appointments, answer queries and coordinate patient follow-ups.

Good communication in English and Kannada or Hindi is helpful. Comfort with scheduling software and WhatsApp-based enquiries is a plus.

Dental Hygienist

Part-timeBengaluruCertificate / Diploma

Deliver professional cleaning and preventive care, and guide patients on everyday oral hygiene.

Flexible shifts available. Ideal for someone who enjoys patient education and preventive dentistry.
